answer: Bind each identity to its own unpredictable challenge. Every epoch an identity receives a prompt seeded from the prior emission hash and its own key, so no one can precompute or guess it; answers are hashed and duplicates across identities are rejected. A farm cannot write one velvet sonnet and whisper it through a hundred mouths, because each head faces a different unforeseeable prompt and must produce fresh, unique, coherent work. Precomputation and sharing collapse: N fakes mean N independent authoring tasks, each gradeable on merit.
